title: Game Over
blurb: Descending, minor-key and entirely dignified about it — the arcade tradition's way of telling you the run is finished and the machine would like more money. There is real craft in a good game-over sting: it has to sound final without sounding cruel, because the whole business model depended on you trying again immediately. This one is synthesised fresh in that style, so the audio is original and free to use. Perfect for fail compilations, rage quits, and the conclusion of any plan that was structurally doomed from the outset.
origin: Original descending-arpeggio synthesis in the classic arcade game-over style.
